user.title: Set up power feedback and infrared actions
user.description: Select a frequently updated power sensor and configure the four actions that control your fan. The fan entity remains unavailable until several stable power reports have been received.

data_description.feedback_burst_action: Runs before fresh power readings are requested; any Home Assistant action can be used.
Runs before fresh power readings are requested; any Home Assistant action can be used.

error.invalid_action: Select at least one valid Home Assistant action.

menu_option_descriptions.control: Change retry behavior and the interval between infrared transmissions.
menu_option_descriptions.power_table: Change off and stationary wattage and the shared oscillation increment.

data_description.max_attempts: A complete initial command is one attempt. Additional attempts are only made after stable feedback does not match the target.
data_description.ir_send_interval: Time between consecutive infrared action executions.
data_description.calibration_mode: Endpoints shifts and scales the current curve from speeds 1 and 10. Full measures every stationary speed.

power_table.title: Power table
power_table.description: Enter the oscillation power increment followed by off and stationary power for speeds 1 through 10.

error.invalid_power_table: Power values must increase with speed, and the oscillation increment must keep every value below 100 W.
